TripRecord.title: TripRecord
TripRecord.description: Represents a recorded movement trip with transport mode, distance, duration, and route telemetry.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this trip record.

dateKey.description: ISO date key YYYY-MM-DD for the trip.

durationMinutes.description: Total duration of the trip in minutes.

startLabel.description: Starting place name or coordinate label.

endLabel.description: Ending place name or coordinate label.

routePointsSerialized.description: Compact semicolon-delimited lat,lng points for map rendering.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PlaceLocation.title: PlaceLocation
PlaceLocation.description: Represents a frequently visited location identified by geofencing and clustering.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this location.

visitCount.description: Total number of visits to this place.

totalDurationMinutes.description: Cumulative minutes spent at this place.

lastArrivalEpochMs.description: Most recent arrival timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

lastDepartureEpochMs.description: Most recent departure timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SleepLog.title: SleepLog
SleepLog.description: Represents an estimated nighttime sleep session derived from stationary and location patterns.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this sleep log.

dateKey.description: Date key YYYY-MM-DD of the sleep session.

durationMinutes.description: Total estimated sleep duration in minutes.

sleepQualityScore.description: Estimated sleep regularity/stationary score from 0 to 100.

notes.description: Optional user notes or schedule annotations.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

WorkSession.title: WorkSession
WorkSession.description: Represents an estimated or manually adjusted working hours session at a workplace location.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this work session.

dateKey.description: Date key YYYY-MM-DD of the work session.

arrivalEpochMs.description: Workplace arrival time in epoch milliseconds.

departureEpochMs.description: Workplace departure time in epoch milliseconds.

isManuallyCorrected.description: Whether the user manually edited this schedule.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/trips/{tripId}.description: Stores cloud-synced movement trips per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/places/{placeId}.description: Stores cloud-synced frequently visited places per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/sleep_logs/{sleepId}.description: Stores cloud-synced estimated sleep logs per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/work_sessions/{workId}.description: Stores cloud-synced estimated and corrected work sessions per authenticated user.
